policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM pire_ai_lesson_students ls
  WHERE ((ls.lesson_id = pire_ai_lessons.id) AND ( SELECT private.current_user_can_access_pire_student(ls.student_id) AS current_user_can_access_pire_student))))

(private.current_user_is_pire_admin() OR ((status = 'Yayında'::text) AND (starts_at <= now()) AND ((ends_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at >= now())) AND ((target_type = ANY (ARRAY['all'::text, 'Tümü'::text, 'tümü'::text])) OR ((target_type = ANY (ARRAY['role'::text, 'Rol'::text, 'rol'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM pire_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (p.status = 'Aktif'::text) AND ((p.role = pire_announcements.target_value) OR (pire_announcements.target_value = ANY (COALESCE(p.roles, ARRAY[]::text[])))))))) OR ((target_type = ANY (ARRAY['profile'::text, 'user'::text, 'Kullanıcı'::text, 'kullanıcı'::text])) AND (target_value = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))))

(private.current_user_is_pire_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM pire_lesson_students pls
  WHERE ((pls.lesson_id = pire_lessons.id) AND private.current_user_can_access_pire_student(pls.student_id)))))
((profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.current_user_is_pire_admin() AS current_user_is_pire_admin))
((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.current_user_is_pire_admin() AS current_user_is_pire_admin))

policies.with_check: (( SELECT private.current_user_is_pire_admin() AS current_user_is_pire_admin) AND (created_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.qual: (( SELECT private.current_user_is_pire_admin() AS current_user_is_pire_admin) AND (created_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM pire_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (COALESCE(p.status, 'Aktif'::text) = 'Aktif'::text))))
((profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.current_user_is_pire_admin() AS current_user_is_pire_admin))
